verdict.summary: Structure holds; motion needs springs not curves.
prescriptions: Tighten institutional palette: cap chroma at 0.04 above L=0.65

why.rationale: Surface scored 4/5: structure holds (typography hierarchy, baseline grid honored), behavior is correct, but motion uses ease-in-out where springs are warranted given the visual mass. Chroma exceeds institutional range. Verdict prescribes specific deltas (mass/stiffness/damping triple, chroma cap) rather than directional guidance because the corrections are measurable.

decisions_considered.option: Defer motion to a later pass
decisions_considered.reason: motion-mass mismatch is a structural finding, not styling
